goal: Die in I136 eingeführten semantischen Vorschau-Abschnitte browserlokal einklappbar machen. Der Zustand bleibt flüchtig, separat vom Draft-Datenobjekt und ohne Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Bereich-Überschriften erhalten einen zugänglichen Ein-/Ausklapp-Toggle mit aria-expanded und aria-controls. Der Zustand lebt ausschließlich in einem flüchtigen Browser-Set.

direct_dependencies: I136 semantic preview sections are confirmed
I135 order remains the sole source of section membership
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run existing test_browser_shell.py as narrow browser-shell regression
collapsed content uses the native hidden state
focus returns to the same section toggle after rerender
removed sections release stale collapse state
collapse state remains outside the draft element object
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
new Chromium screenshot evidence because this is not the scheduled visual milestone
risks: collapse state must not leak into future persistence accidentally
focus must not be lost after rerender
aria-expanded must reflect the visible state of the controlled list
removing a section must not leave stale collapse state
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: visible sections can be collapsed and expanded directly in preview
the section heading remains the accessible toggle label
collapsed state survives ordinary browser rerenders but not page reload
